title: Great way to keep your silverware and utensils organized and available!
text: Great way to keep your silverware and utensils organized and available!. I live in a new subdivision in Florida where the neighbors get together all the time. Twice I have hosted events in my home and had to put my silverware out on a countertop. Not a great organized way to display the forks and knives and it actually took up a lot of unnecessary countertop space. When I saw this I wanted to see how it would work. Last weekend I used it for the first time and it was a huge success. First, it is attractive and blends easily with my brushed nickel sink and stainless steel appliances. Second, it is compact and takes up less space. And last, it has compartments for the various types of utensils (and keeps everything organized). I am thrilled to be using this and will continue to keep it in my kitchen pantry for future parties and events!

product_metadata.title: SZUAH Cutlery Caddy Holder, Stainless Steel Flatware Silverware Caddy Organizer, with 4 Compartments for Kitchen Counter & Dining Table
features: PREMIUM MATERIAL: made of premium stainless steel and food grade ABS resin, rust proof & corrosion proof; it will last for a long time..

LARGE CAPACITY: 4 compartments large enough to hold and separate your spoons, forks and knives, keep them upright for your easy getting, to take up minimal counter space and great to get your utensil drawers clean.
REMOVAL DIVIDER & BOTTOM: PP resin dividers and bottom can be removed for easy & thoroughly cleaning, Dishwasher safe and BPA free,

POUR SPOUT at BOTTOM: the OBLIQUE inner bottom catches water and allows water in the caddy to flow automatically into your sink through the pour spout, no worry about mouldy any more and save your time to clean.

SIZE and GURANTEE: 7.3" long, 5.6" high, 3.3" wide. Nice-looking stainless steel keeps your utensils handy and your counter tidy. Fabulous gift choice with a colorful box. GURANTEE: if you are not satisfied with it, please feel free to contact us, refund or replacement is available per you request.
